audience: rental operations managers who run jobs and stock in Current RMS

useCases.title: Check if a product is available for a job
useCases.text: The AI checks rental availability of a product over a date range, with quantity held, booked and available, or lists stock for all products per store.

useCases.title: Review opportunities by stage
useCases.text: The AI lists enquiries, drafts, quotations and orders, for example orders not invoiced yet, and opens one to read its dates, charge totals and line items.

useCases.title: Find invoices and credit notes
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices and credit notes by number, customer name or status and opens one to read its due date, totals and lines.

useCases.title: Find a customer, venue or contact
useCases.text: The AI searches members (organisations, contacts, venues and users) by name, email, phone or tag and opens one with its addresses, links and custom fields.

useCases.title: Create an opportunity for a customer
useCases.text: The AI creates an enquiry, draft or quotation for a customer with a store, dates and subject. Line items are added later in Current RMS.

useCases.title: Add or update a customer, or log a call or note
useCases.text: The AI creates an organisation, contact or venue, updates a member, or logs a call, meeting, task or note against a member, opportunity or project.
